name: Legacy two-plan pricing
purpose: Show the price of a paid service in two tiers and list what every plan includes, so the reader can pick a tier.
description: Legacy purple-hairline (#570039) block: centred serif 4rem H2 header over a shrink-to-fit 2-plan grid (second plan tinted #3b041d); each plan = name, serif 3rem price, period, then a count label (+ optional note) with a large count at the bottom-right. Below, a centred 36rem feature list: grey lead line + rows with top/left hairlines. Plans stack to one column <=479. No variants or theme prop.
